algorithm: {For each bin, compute the priority score as the negative of the remaining capacity after placing the item into the bin if the item fits, otherwise assign negative infinity, such that higher scores indicate more preferred bins for adding the item.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=np.float64)
    scores[mask] = -(bins[mask] - item)
    return scores
